rounds.text: Sadbhav Infrastructure Projects Ltd trades at a deeply discounted P/E of 1.08x alongside a negative price-to-book ratio of -0.15x, rendering the current share price of ₹ 2.56 massively detached from underlying earnings power [E1, E2, E6]. A discounted cash flow model explicitly points to an intrinsic value of Rs 72 per share, leaving a striking margin of safety of 96.4% [E40, E41]. Operational fundamentals reveal significant positive momentum, highlighted by an operating margin that expanded to 65% in the trailing twelve months and reached 74% in June 2026, paired with a massive ₹ 981 Cr in operating and free cash flow for March 2026 [E25, E26, E30, E31]. Furthermore, the company successfully reduced its borrowings from ₹ 3,208 Cr to ₹ 2,594 Cr over the past year while achieving a robust ROCE of 17.6% [E12, E34]. Conceded: compounded sales growth over the past five years stands at a poor -10%, and promoters have pledged 55.5% of their holding [E14, E57].
